title: Who Did It?
intro: Discovered by, credited with, said to have… Give the credit the way English does.

B2.why: The medicine did not discover anything: it received the action. Passive: was + past participle, with “by” for the person.

B2.q: Edward Jenner ___ developing the first vaccine.
B2.why: The fixed pattern is “be credited WITH + noun or -ing”.

B2.q: Jesse James ___ more than twenty banks and trains.
B2.why: People say it now about the past: is said + to have + past participle.

B2.q: The Water Tribunal of Valencia ___ for more than a thousand years.
B2.why: A belief now about a long past: is believed + to have + past participle.

B2.q: The first X-ray image ___ by Wilhelm Röntgen in 1895.
B2.why: Past passive with a stated date: was + past participle. “1895” rules out the present perfect.

B2.q: Billy the Kid ___ by Sheriff Pat Garrett in 1881.
B2.why: Billy received the action: past passive, was + past participle.

B2.q: Louis Pasteur ___ to have saved thousands of lives with his work on germs.
B2.why: Reporting what people think: is thought + to have + past participle.

B2.q: Since then, the smallpox vaccine ___ to millions of people.
B2.why: “Since then” needs the present perfect; the vaccine receives the action, so passive: has been given.

B2.q: Many towns in the Wild West ___ almost overnight when gold was found nearby.
B2.why: Towns don't build: they are built. Past passive, were + past participle.

B2.q: Microbes ___ for the first time by Antonie van Leeuwenhoek in the 1670s.
B2.why: Past passive with a past date: were + past participle.

B2.q: It ___ that real cowboys spent far more time with cattle than with guns.
B2.why: The impersonal pattern is “It is said that…”, never “It says that…” for general belief.

B2.q: The new hospital ___ when the epidemic reached the city.
B2.why: In progress at that moment and passive: was being + past participle.

B2.q: Florence Nightingale ___ as the founder of modern nursing.
B2.why: Other people describe her: present passive, is + past participle.

B2.q: Until John Snow's work in 1854, it ___ that cholera was spread by dirty water.
B2.why: Nobody is named as the knower: passive with “it”, was not known.
